status: EXPLORATORY pilot P1 of docs/13 amendment A5, arm (i), seed 100 (the first seed; seeds 101 and 102 only in the extension). Supports no claim. Validation and test are NOT used: selection on H' residue 2a, judgement on H' residue 2b.
docs: docs/13 A5 (P1, GO / NO-GO / grey), A4 (H9.3, H' roles, controls), docs/11 sections 11.4 to 11.6; model src/tmlm/cvtm/crtm.py
train_positions_rule: sampled without replacement (SeedSequence([seed, SALT_POS, 1])) among the residue-1 positions whose gold is among the core top-64 (the candidate set)
negatives_rule: K = 4 distinct slots of the core top-64 without the gold, drawn without replacement with probabilities proportional to P_core (Gumbel top-K, counter-based uniforms keyed by seed, stable document ID, offset, slot)
split_2ab: residue-2 documents ordered by mix64(doc_id XOR 0x2AB2AB) (ties by doc_id): the first 130 are 2a (selection), the other 131 are 2b (judgement); independent of the seed
candidates: top-64 of P_core (cache arrays core_top_ids, core_top_p; H' base: frozen EM weights over the KN-5 fitted without H')
readout: P proportional to P_core exp(beta_b s' + a_b) on the top-64 with the exact normaliser; s' standardised on the 2a pairs; per configuration a pooled (beta, a) fitted on 2a gives the selection metric (2a bits per token); the chosen configuration gets per-bucket (beta_b, a_b) (520 buckets, MAP towards the pooled pair, 16 pseudo-positions) fitted on 2a; 2b scored once

tm.clauses_note: A5 '4,000 clauses' read as the total of the binary TM: 2 classes x 2,000 (tmu number_of_clauses is per class; the earlier exploratory copy gate used 2,000 per class as well)
tm.tmu: TMClassifier(number_of_clauses, T, s, platform='CPU', weighted_clauses=True, seed=seed); Type I and II feedback (tmu defaults)

c0_rule: 1 percent of the training positions (SeedSequence([seed, 0xC0, 1])) with all their pairs; the same TM grid and epochs (6 configurations)

controls.l2_note: descending; each fit warm-starts from the previous solution; 6 configurations per LR gate
controls.budget_note: timing probes on the real cache (not reported): LR2 about 8 s per objective evaluation on 1.25M pairs, so 100 iterations per L2 value on the warm-start path; TM about 18 min per epoch; HGB about 1 s per tree per fit and 20 min per 200-tree 2a pass
controls.refit_note: if the chosen LR or LR2 configuration stopped at its iteration cap it is refitted once with the cap raised four-fold (the D0.2 rule of A5 for H9.2, applied here too); a refit that still stops at the cap is reported
controls.hgb_note: 3 fits x 2 tree counts = 6 configurations (learning rate x trees spans 10 to 80); scored by an exact numba walker of the sklearn trees (crtm.hgb_staged_scores, checked against decision_function on 3,000 2a pairs per fit); raw-feature design matrix (crtm.hgb_layout): numeric columns for thermometer families, categorical columns for one-hot families, one 0/1 column per bit literal; early_stopping off; random_state = seed

ablations: TM_norel: MAIN without the relational family (eq_k and cluster-bag literals)
TM_ctxid: context literals plus the candidate id (hierarchical code), the NCE-bank objective without the engine change
ablation_rule: the chosen TM (T, s); epochs 1..chosen epoch, the best of them on 2a

bootstrap.statistic: per resample: sum of bits / sum of UTF-8 bytes of the drawn documents, a minus b

verdict_arm_i: GO(i): 2b gain over the core >= 0.012 bits per byte with the CI excluding 0 AND TM minus the best of {LR, LR2, HGB} (chosen on 2a) <= -0.003 with the CI excluding 0 AND TM minus C0 <= -0.005. NO-GO part: gain < 0.005 or TM minus best control > 0

compute.workers: parent builds the stores, then 2 forked workers (tm, ctl), 1 thread each
compute.work_dir: temporary folder, deleted at the end

launch: scripts/cpu_slot.sh 2 -- nice -n 19 .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --no-gpu-sampler --name cvtm_pilot_p1_arm1_seed100_exploratory --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_pilot_p1_arm1_seed100.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_pilot_p1.py arm1 --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_pilot_p1_arm1_seed100.json --work <scratch>
